GENERATE BURST KS-fire-expanded-01 — E0-p step 5: the "EXPANDED" KEY STATE of the fire burst, painted over the tooling-transformed piece arrangement (Run C-5; architecture 03- § 2.2b step 5; Astra S1 § 2b conditions: fixed canvas, the original state in every call, a tooling-generated target guide, ONE change per call). task_id "KS-fire-expanded-01".

IMAGE 1 is the ORIGINAL approved fire impact peak on the same 768×768 canvas (the intact body; four greyscale planes; Matt-accepted) — the identity every pixel must keep. IMAGE 2 is the TOOLING GUIDE: the same pieces of IMAGE 1 mechanically stretched outward (frame 15 of the runtime: tongues stretched 2–2.5× along their axes, roots drifted outward, core swollen) by the runtime at 1:1 on the same 768×768 transparent canvas — this arrangement is the SHAPE CONTRACT (where every tongue and the core are, how far they reach). IMAGE 3 is the scale + register board (two 130-px figures = 1 BH; the hand-drawn contour register).

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 2 and deliver ONE 768×768 image with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background: the arrangement of IMAGE 2 RE-PAINTED so that it reads as one drawn frame of fire — the tongues at full reach drawn as continuous licks of flame with their own inner planes, the joins between stretched pieces healed, the core reading as a swollen bright heart — while every piece stays where IMAGE 2 puts it (each tongue's root, axis and tip within ~6 px of the guide; the core where the guide has it; no piece added, removed or moved). Keep IMAGE 1's vocabulary exactly: GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FOUR flat value planes with hard edges (near-black contour/rim, dark grey outer flame, light grey mid flame, white core), the same line weight, no gradients/glow/blur/colour/texture, no ground, shadow, sparks, smoke, motion blur or text. This is ONE change: re-drawing the transformed pieces as a coherent painting — not a new composition.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if: a piece moved/added/vanished against the guide, the background is not clean, gradients/glow/soft edges or more than four planes appear, or the line weight changed — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/fire_expanded_01.png with sha256 (no conversion, no trim). No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "KS-fire-expanded-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/fire_expanded_01.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly (state whether the output has real transparency).

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the original approved peak on the same 768 canvas (identity)
IMAGE 2 — TOOLING GUIDE: the transformed pieces at 1:1 (shape contract)
